CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS digest_records (
    doc INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    removed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    rid INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    n INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    claim INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    stamped INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    dl INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    client TEXT,
    model TEXT,
    category TEXT,
    sha TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    scopes TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    cwd TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    tokens TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS digest_records_by_id ON digest_records(removed, id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS digest_records_by_category
    ON digest_records(removed, category);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS digest_tokens (
    token TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    doc INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    PRIMARY KEY (token, doc)
) WITHOUT ROWID;
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS digest_state (
    key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    value TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
) WITHOUT ROWID;
read: created: Store.create(<scratch>/store, keys_dir=<scratch>/keys) under the fixed values; created_after_orphans: the same with an empty store/memory.sqlite.orphaned-20010203T040506Z.sqlite beside it first. tables: every table (sqlite_master type 'table', by name), its columns, and its rows in rowid order (rowid first) or, for a WITHOUT ROWID table, by the first column; a value is JSON, a blob {blob: hex}, a float {real: repr}. key_ring: each file of the keys directory, its mode as asked for (checked on POSIX), the text of head, origin and binding (the scratch directory as <scratch>), the key's sha256. refusals: each case's setup, the class raised, the errno's name for an OSError, else the message, and the entries the refused create left beside the setup's.

restore_marker_beside.message: <scratch>/store/memory.sqlite is not opened: a restore of it did not finish (started 2001-02-03T04:05:06Z, by process 12, from /bundles/b\x1b1, stopped at swap; <scratch>/store/memory.sqlite.restore-lock keeps its record), and the store may be part restored. Run the restore again to finish it (`bettermemory backup restore /bundles/b\x1b1 --yes`), or open the store as it stands after `bettermemory backup unlock --yes`
